title: The polo, folded
logline: The maroon polo folded on a shelf in the garage, not on its hanger. Whether the shifts have ended or it's laundry day: the page doesn't say. The hanger empty on the hook is the page's only statement.

panels.composition: A maroon polo shirt folded on a garage shelf and, beside it on the door's hook, an empty wire hanger, lamplight.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a maroon polo shirt folded on a garage shelf and an empty wire hanger on the door's hook beside it, lamplight, no words
image.notes: Whether the motel years end: reserved.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
